arxiv-2108-08174.title: Harmonic dual dressing of spin one-half systems
arxiv-2108-08174.creator: Giuseppe Bevilacqua, Valerio Biancalana, T. Zanon-Willette, Ennio Arimondo
arxiv-2108-08174.description: Abstract Controlled modifications of the magnetic response of a two-level system are produced in dressed systems by one high frequency, strong and non-resonant electromagnetic field. This quantum control is greatly enhanced and enriched by a harmonic, commensurable and orthogonally oriented dual dressing, as discussed here.

arxiv-2512-12583.title: Detecting Prompt Injection Attacks Against Application Using Classifiers
arxiv-2512-12583.creator: Safwan Shaheer, G. M. Refatul Islam, Mohammad Rafid Hamid, Md. Abrar Faiaz Khan, Md. Omar Faruk, Yaseen Nur
arxiv-2512-12583.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Safwan Shaheer, G. M. Refatul Islam, Mohammad Rafid Hamid, Md. Abrar Faiaz Khan, Md. Omar Faruk, Yaseen Nur. Prompt injection attacks are a growing concern in various domains, as they can compromise the security and stability of critical systems, from power grids to large-scale web applications.

arxiv-2602-20308.title: Hyperuniformity in active fluids reshape nucleation and capillary-wave dynamics
arxiv-2602-20308.creator: Raphaël Maire
arxiv-2602-20308.description: Abstract While nucleation in typical active and driven fluids often appears equilibrium-like, striking departures emerge when large-scale fluctuations are strongly suppressed. Here, we investigate nucleation in nonequilibrium hyperuniform fluids by projecting the full density-field dynamics onto relevant collective variables. We demonstrate that nucleation is governed by a nonequilibrium quasi-potential rather than the reversible work of formation.

pmc-10612008.title: Effect of Short, Animated Video Storytelling on Maternal Knowledge and Satisfaction in the Perinatal Period in South Africa: Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-10612008.creator: Maya Adam, Zwannda Kwinda, Mithilesh Dronavalli, Elizabeth Leonard, Vān Kính Nguyễn, Vusani Tshivhase, Till Bärnighausen, Yogan Pillay, Amaryllis Mavragani, Hadas Miremberg, Marta Roqueta Vall-llosera
pmc-10612008.description: BackgroundInnovative mobile health (mHealth) interventions can improve maternal knowledge, thereby supporting national efforts to reduce preventable maternal and child mortality in South Africa. Studies have documented a potential role for mobile video content to support perinatal health messaging, enhance maternal satisfaction, and overcome literacy barriers. Short, animated storytelling (SAS) is an innovative, emerging approach to mHealth messaging.

pmc-10808373.title: Non-destructive real-time analysis of plant metabolite accumulation in radish microgreens under different LED light recipes
pmc-10808373.creator: Marco Garegnani, Carla Sandri, Claudia Pacelli, Francesca Ferranti, Elisabetta Bennici, Angiola Desiderio, Luca Nardi, Maria Elena Villani
pmc-10808373.description: IntroductionThe future of human space missions relies on the ability to provide adequate food resources for astronauts and also to reduce stress due to the environment (microgravity and cosmic radiation). In this context, microgreens have been proposed for the astronaut diet because of their fast-growing time and their high levels of bioactive compounds and nutrients (vitamins, antioxidants, minerals, etc.

pmc-11314934.title: MixImages: An Urban Perception AI Method Based on Polarization Multimodalities
pmc-11314934.creator: Yan Mo, Wanting Zhou, Wei Chen, Anastasios Doulamis
pmc-11314934.description: Intelligent urban perception is one of the hot topics. Most previous urban perception models based on semantic segmentation mainly used RGB images as unimodal inputs. However, in natural urban scenes, the interplay of light and shadow often leads to confused RGB features, which diminish the model’s perception ability.

pmc-11531128.title: A multi-trait epigenome-wide association study identified DNA methylation signature of inflammation among men with HIV
pmc-11531128.creator: Junyu Chen, Qin Hui, Boghuma K Titanji, Kaku So-Armah, Matthew Freiberg, Amy C Justice, Ke Xu, Xiaofeng Zhu, Marta Gwinn, Vincent C Marconi, Yan V Sun
pmc-11531128.description: Inflammation underlies many conditions causing excess morbidity and mortality among people with HIV (PWH). A handful of single-trait epigenome-wide association studies (EWAS) have suggested that inflammation is associated with DNA methylation (DNAm) among PWH. Multi-trait EWAS may further improve statistical power and reveal pathways in common between different inflammatory markers.

pmc-11658322.title: Borderline personality disorder in Trichotillomania and skin picking disorder: a survey study
pmc-11658322.creator: Jon E. Grant, Madison Collins, Samuel R. Chamberlain
pmc-11658322.description: BackgroundComorbidity studies in trichotillomania and skin picking disorder (known as Body-Focused Repetitive Behaviors, BFRBs) have traditionally not examined rates of borderline personality disorder. When it co-occurs, borderline personality disorder may necessitate different treatment approaches and if untreated may interfere with the response to the treatment for trichotillomania or skin picking disorder.

pmc-11697558.title: Protocol for in situ and in vivo dissection of mouse lung-draining lymph nodes
pmc-11697558.creator: Enshuo Zhang, Baicheng Zhao, Yupeng Liu, Gang Liu, Shuting Lu, Liqin Xiong, Xufeng Pan, Haitang Yang, Feng Yao
pmc-11697558.description: SummaryLung-draining lymph nodes (LNs) play crucial roles in infection, inflammation, and cancer, but in situ and in vivo studying models are technically challenging. Here, we present a protocol for the in situ and in vivo dissection of mouse lung-draining LNs, ensuring postoperative survival. We describe steps for lymphadenectomy including localizing lung-draining LNs, open thoracotomy, and LN dissection.

pmc-12610066.description: Lycium ruthenicum Murr. (Black goji), a medicinal and economically valuable crop rich in bioactive compounds, remains genomically understudied despite its expanding cultivation. To overcome limitations of traditional markers in genetic diversity analysis and molecular breeding, we employed specific-locus amplified fragment sequencing (SLAF-seq) to develop genome-wide SNP markers and elucidate the genetic structure of 213 L.

pmc-12650989.title: Zingerone Targets LKB1/AMPK to Block FcεRI-Dependent Mast Cell Degranulation and Anaphylaxis
pmc-12650989.creator: Defeng Zheng, Hui Zhang, Can Mao, Jinqiang Liang, Xian Li, Premalatha Balachandran
pmc-12650989.description: AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) acts as a cellular energy sensor and a central regulator of metabolism. Recent studies indicate that pharmacological AMPK activation can simultaneously ameliorate metabolic disorders (e.g., type II diabetes, obesity) and allergic diseases. Zingerone, a primary bioactive compound in ginger, demonstrates protective effects in vascular calcification, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, and asthma via AMPK activation.

pmc-12768413.title: Valaciclovir therapy for secondary suppression of immune response to herpesviruses: An exploratory study
pmc-12768413.creator: Kirsty McGee, Alex Dowell, Sarah Lauder, Jusnara Begum, Odette Chagoury, Wayne Croft, Lee Middleton, Yongzhong Sun, Jianmin Zuo, Richard McManus, Paul Moss
pmc-12768413.description: Herpesviruses establish a state of persistent infection which is suppressed by sustained virus-specific immune control. The magnitude of this immune response can increase with age and lead to attrition of immune reserve against other pathogens. Approaches which suppress herpesvirus-specific immunity may therefore have the potential to improve general immune function.

pmc-13279453.title: Effectiveness of an Intervention to Improve Guideline‐Directed Medications for Patients With Acute Heart Failure: A Randomized Clinical Trial
pmc-13279453.creator: Jung‐Woo Son, Dong‐Hyuk Cho, Se‐Eun Kim, Jimi Choi, Dong‐Ju Choi, Hyun‐Jai Cho, Chan Joo Lee, Jin Oh Choi, Sang Eun Lee, Eung Ju Kim, Wook‐Jin Chung, Jong‐Chan Youn, Dae‐Hwan Bae, Jae‐Hyeong Park, Kye Hun Kim, In‐Cheol Kim, Jung‐Hyun Choi, Sunki Lee, Hokon Kim, Byung‐Su Yoo
pmc-13279453.description: BackgroundGuideline‐directed medical therapy during the transitional period is crucial for improving outcomes in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction. We investigated whether a simplified transitional care intervention could increase guideline‐directed medical therapy adherence in patients with acute heart failure (HF).MethodsThis multicenter, open‐label randomized trial enrolled 982 patients with acute HF.

pmc-13681461.title: The emerging role of subchondral bone homeostasis in osteoarthritis
pmc-13681461.creator: Antonia Donat, Weixin Xie, Assil-Ramin Alimy, Anke Baranowsky, Tim Rolvien, Johannes Keller
pmc-13681461.description: The treatment of progressive articular cartilage degeneration and consequent joint deterioration, also known as osteoarthritis (OA), remains a major challenge in musculoskeletal medicine. The subchondral bone has become a key area of research, as early alterations in bone remodelling and structure may precede cartilage degeneration and contribute to disease initiation and progression.
